title: Michael Wm. Kaluta
description: "Every great being has humble beginnings, proclaims Michael Wm. Kaluta. "I see young Ackbar's schoolmates strugglin together with the finer points of this difficult training... In 1969 the prolific Kaluta began working for DC Comics. Jobs on BATMAN, DETECTlVE and one of his most critically-acclaimed assignments, THE SHADOW, followed. Other well-known works include STARSTRUCK (for Marvel/Epic), MY NAME IS PARIS, BILL THE GALACTIC HERO and THE ABYSS.
